rationale: REVISE round 2 for fdb032c6 (bugs_open/309 source-vocabulary birth gate). Every objection from round 1 is answered with a change or a measurement — nothing is argued away. (3) bug_historian's outage objection (fail-open aspect read = only a logger.Warn) is CLOSED BY CODE in the same commit: a failed aspect-vocabulary read now writes a DURABLE agent_error_log row (SOURCE_GUARD_ASPECT_SET_UNAVAILABLE, via the existing LogActionFindings channel) naming the component stored with the aspect half skipped — and the second wiring test exercises exactly this branch: aspect read errors, the skip is recorded, and the DB-free query-name half still refuses. That correction also retires the stale line in round 1's rationale: the earlier correlation df8ca3a1 named a run that never dispatched. (9) debug_historian's deploy-verification ask, stated as the plan: after the next fleet roll, per-service provenance check (`kubectl logs -l app=agent-chassis | grep -m1 'build provenance'` then `git merge-base --is-ancestor e5c9029dc <stamp>`, falling back to the /proc/1/exe known-sha probe with present+absent controls), then a DEMAND control — the first natural (or one induced) phantom-source generation must produce the queryable rejection row; recorded as CLC-018's verify-later. (10) reuse_agent's guard-accumulation note is acknowledged as real and out of scope: the Layer-1 sequence now carries five bespoke guards; consolidation is registered as a known refactor direction in CLC-018's relations rather than silently attempted here. plan.risks: 1) The action-level tests pin two specific SQL shapes (the existing-component SELECT prefix and SELECT DISTINCT aspect FROM site_specs); a future rewrite of either query re-shapes the mocks — ordinary test maintenance, stated so it is not mistaken for behavioural coupling. 2) The durable fail-open record inherits provenance (LogActionFindings with inherit=true) and best-effort semantics — a DB so broken it cannot write agent_error_log while also failing the aspect read leaves only the Warn; accepted, since a store against a DB in that state fails at the INSERT anyway. 3) The guard remains inert in production until a chassis image rolls; deploy verification plan as stated in the rationale (provenance stamp ancestry + a demand-control rejection), recorded in CLC-018's verify-later. 4) Round 1's risks 1–3 (calibration construction, regeneration trap for the 11, switch→map mechanical equivalence) stand unchanged and unre-litigated.
